source_note: Concurrent shared working tree. Selected file hashes were read after the runs; observed replay identity is checked independently using the recorded state checkpoints.
limits: Counterfactuals isolate sensitivity; they do not validate physical aircraft coefficients.
Cases ending before49.0916667s stopped early at ground/crash and must not be called stable full-flight solutions.
trim22/trim25 also change starting airspeed and all solved trims; manual22at5 changes only elevator trim through the live API at5s.
Neutral and fixed half/quarter power cases discard observed raw inputs.

For original manual22at5/no_gyro result rows, reported component forces were evaluated quasi-statically without downwash lag. State trajectories and replay comparison were produced by the full session with its lag; do not use those component rows as actual transient-load evidence.

APC cases switch a single-RPM curve at5s, preserve legacy RPM-lag, and last15s. Their first inversions precede the first J extrapolation; later trajectories include extrapolated data. This is sensitivity evidence, not a calibrated powertrain replacement.
